//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the KPI NUMERIC STRIP container — the `.pa-kpi-strip` block (keen `PureAdmin.Components.KpiStrip.kpi_strip/1`, svelte `display/KpiStrip.svelte`). SCOPE = CONTAINER + AUTO-GENERATED HEADER ROW. Unlike the bare stacked-bar/accent-grid/dot-leaders containers, this component is a `pa-card`-based SHELL that emits a non-trivial tree on its own: the card wrapper (pa-card pa-kpi-strip [--no-*]), an OPTIONAL header (pa-card__header pa-kpi-header with title + the LIVE pill), the body (pa-card__body pa-kpi-strip__body), an AUTO-GENERATED header row built FROM the visible-column set (pa-kpi-strip__head-row with pa-kpi-strip__head cells, --num on the numeric columns, and the --prev/--delta/--target hide-target modifiers), and an OPTIONAL footer (pa-card__footer pa-kpi-footer). All of that is container markup and is in scope. The DATA ROWS are a SEPARATE sub-component (svelte KpiStripRow, keen kpi_strip_row/1) fed through the default slot, which both dumpers pass as plain escaped TEXT — so the per-row element classes (pa-kpi-strip__row / __metric / __now / __num / __unit / __prev / __delta[/--*] / __target / __bar / __fill / __bar-pct) cannot materialize and are DEFERRED as acknowledged prose (no row-fragment fixture/dumper clause exists to fixture-ref). The --no-prev/--no-delta/--no-target BLOCK modifiers are driven by the noPrev/noDelta/noTarget toggles AND drop the matching head cell, so each toggle scenario proves both the block modifier AND the head-row adjusting its visible cells.

propsVocabulary.title: card title — when set, emits the header (pa-card__header pa-kpi-header) with the canonical card title shape (pa-card__title > h3.pa-card__title-text). svelte `titleText`, keen `title_text`.
propsVocabulary.live: LIVE pill — pa-kpi-live + pa-kpi-live__dot, shown next to the title in the header. svelte `isLive`, keen `is_live`.
propsVocabulary.footer: footer caption — emits pa-card__footer pa-kpi-footer with a <span>. svelte `footerText`, keen `footer_text`.
propsVocabulary.noHeader: suppress the auto-generated header row (no pa-kpi-strip__head-row). svelte `noHeader`, keen `no_header`.
propsVocabulary.noPrev: drop the prev column — pa-kpi-strip--no-prev + drops the __head--prev cell. svelte `noPreviousValue`, keen `no_previous_value`.
propsVocabulary.noDelta: drop the Δ% column — pa-kpi-strip--no-delta + drops the __head--delta cell. svelte `noDeltaPercent`, keen `no_delta_percent`.
propsVocabulary.noTarget: drop the target-bar column — pa-kpi-strip--no-target + drops the __head--target cell. svelte `noTargetBar`, keen `no_target_bar`.
propsVocabulary.body: the strip's row area — filled with plain slot text in this slice (the real pa-kpi-strip__row children are the deferred row sub-component). svelte `children`, keen `inner_block`.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the card (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: The strip is a pa-card SHELL. Goldens show the full container tree: the card wrapper + (when title/live set) the header + the body + the auto-generated head-row + (when footer set) the footer. The auto head-row is the KEY in-scope behaviour: the visible-column set is [metric, now, (prev), (delta), (target)] with the optional columns dropped by the matching --no-* toggle, and each visible column emits a pa-kpi-strip__head cell carrying --num on the numeric columns (now/prev/delta) and the --prev/--delta/--target hide-target modifier on those three. The body slot is a plain text token (Body) standing in for the deferred row children. The default header label text (Metric / Now / Prev / Δ% / vs Target) is part of the contract and appears verbatim in the head cells. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away by the comparator, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature->class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-kpi-strip(--|__)'). BLOCK modifiers: --no-prev/--no-delta/--no-target (the three composable column toggles). The container also emits the __body + the auto head-row (__head-row, __head, __head--num, __head--prev/--delta/--target) — those are exercised directly by the scenario goldens, so they need no `produces` feature (an element class exercised by a golden is covered on axis-1). __head--metric / __head--now have NO CSS rule (inert column identifiers) and don't appear as selectors. The per-ROW element classes (__row/__metric/__now/__num/__unit/__prev/__delta[/--*]/__target/__bar/__fill/__bar-pct) are owned by the deferred row sub-component. title/live/footer/noHeader toggle structural shell parts (header / LIVE pill / footer / head-row presence) that aren't pa-kpi-strip--* modifiers → produces:null.

title.note: structural — emits the header with the canonical pa-card__title > h3.pa-card__title-text shape (pa-card block, not pa-kpi-strip)

live.note: structural — the pa-kpi-live LIVE pill (pa-kpi-base block, not pa-kpi-strip)

footer.note: structural — the pa-card__footer pa-kpi-footer (card + kpi-base blocks)

noHeader.note: structural — suppresses the auto-generated pa-kpi-strip__head-row (negative toggle: no class produced)

body.note: structural — the container's inner content (row area); real rows are the deferred row sub-component

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim to the card, not a core feature

deferred.//: Per-ROW element + state classes of the pa-kpi-strip block — NOT container markup. They are emitted by the SEPARATE row sub-component (svelte KpiStripRow.svelte, keen kpi_strip_row/1) fed through the default slot, which both dumpers pass as plain escaped TEXT, so they cannot materialize here, and there is NO row-fragment fixture/dumper clause to fixture-ref (a ref would DEFER?-fail). Acknowledged as prose. The bare __delta renders the positive colour; __delta--* are the five sentiment variants. __fill carries an inline width (style='width:N%'), never a class. The container's OWN __body + the auto head-row element classes (__head-row/__head/__head--num/__head--prev/--delta/--target) are NOT deferred — they're exercised by the scenario goldens.
deferred.pa-kpi-strip__row: data row + hover host for the detail popover — row sub-component (KpiStripRow / kpi_strip_row), slot-fed, not container markup
deferred.pa-kpi-strip__unit: the unit/prefix affix inside __now — row sub-component
deferred.pa-kpi-strip__delta: Δ% cell (bare = positive colour) — row sub-component
deferred.pa-kpi-strip__delta--up-strong: Δ% sentiment variant (strong up) — row sub-component
deferred.pa-kpi-strip__delta--down-strong: Δ% sentiment variant (strong down) — row sub-component
deferred.pa-kpi-strip__fill: target bar fill — row sub-component; width set INLINE (style), never a class
deferred.pa-kpi-strip__bar-pct: percent label under the target bar — row sub-component
